description: This file contains a test suite called 'LowCoverageViewSmokeTests' that verifies the building of various UI components and interactions within a macOS application. The tests include constructing views, binding states, and simulating user interactions, primarily focusing on UI component rendering and behavior.

methods.name: context menu card builds body
methods.description: Tests constructing ContextMenuCardView with different states (loading, empty, with rows) and accessing its body property.

methods.name: settings toggle row builds body
methods.description: Creates a SettingsToggleRow with a binding and accesses its body to ensure proper rendering.

methods.name: voice wake test card builds body across states
methods.description: Simulates different voice wake test states and verifies the VoiceWakeTestCard view builds correctly in each state.

methods.name: agent events window builds body with event
methods.description: Pushes a sample agent event into the store, builds the AgentEventsWindow view, and clears the store afterward.

methods.name: notify overlay presents and dismisses
methods.description: Tests presenting and dismissing the notify overlay controller, including async waiting.

methods.name: talk overlay presents twice and dismisses
methods.description: Tests presenting, updating, and dismissing the talk overlay controller, including async waiting.

methods.name: visual effect view hosts in NS hosting view
methods.description: Creates an NSHostingView with VisualEffectView, updates the root view, and checks sizes.

methods.name: menu hosted item hosts content
methods.description: Creates a MenuHostedItem with a Text view, hosts it in NSHostingView, and updates the view.

methods.name: dock icon manager updates visibility
methods.description: Checks changing the dock icon visibility via DockIconManager.

methods.name: voice wake settings exercises helpers
methods.description: Calls a helper function related to voice wake settings for testing purposes.

methods.name: debug settings exercises helpers
methods.description: Calls async helper for debug settings testing.
